name: vscode-inferql
description: SQL completion and types for InferQL's sql(...): keywords, tables and columns at the cursor, each column with its table, database type and TypeScript type.

inferql.dialect.description: The dialect, when the project's tsconfig.json has no inferql content mapper entry to read it from: sqlite, mysql or postgres.

inferql.migrationsDir.description: The migrations directory, relative to the project (the folder of the nearest package.json). Read from tsconfig.json's inferql content mapper entry when there is one.

inferql.databaseUrl.description: The connection string, for MySQL and PostgreSQL. SQLite needs none: the migrations are applied to an in-memory database.
